CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Nov 10 — Inter Women 1-4 Manchester City in Monza. Bartoli 24', Fujino 33' and 44', Casparij 56', Clinton 70'.
CONFIRMED · Inter.it · Nov 10 — The club says tests found a muscle strain in Ange-Yoan Bonny's right hamstring.
REPORTED · French and Serbian federations via Football Italia · Nov 10 — Marcus Thuram and Aleksandar Stankovic both left their national teams with muscle injuries.
REPORTED · FCInter1908 · Nov 10 — Bonny is expected to be out about four weeks. The club has published no date.
